value.rationale: The complete arithmetic Fourier response of the canonical three-dimensional regular cross-polytope is a natural intrinsic invariant: it is confined exactly to the six type-D3 reflection hyperplanes, with an exact 24N²+2N+1 count rather than a generic Fourier decay statement. This exact spectral statement yields an all-scale periodization whose three possible lattice-covering multiplicities have fixed and nontrivial volume fractions 1/6, 1/3, 1/2; it applies to arbitrary generic translation and every positive integer radius. The exact coefficient table and distribution answer natural lattice diffraction and covering questions not supplied as explicit outcomes of the general prior methods. Only the general cubic-linear polynomial structure is known beforehand and is not sold as new.
